info.name: Retrieve and format stored document as markdown

params.name: show_code_references
params.description: Include code references in user stories

params.name: search
params.description: Free-text; supports exact, "a or b", or "a and b"

items.docs:
Retrieves a stored document (PRD, Technical Specification, or Document Section) from the database
    and formats it into a clean, readable markdown document.

    This endpoint fetches the latest PRD for the given project and formats it based on the doc_type.

    Document types:
    - prd: Full Product Requirements Document
    - technical-spec: Full Technical Specification
    - document-section: Individual document section (requires section query parameter)

info.name: Export document as PDF from markdown input

params.name: doc_type
params.description: Optional document type for filename generation

items.docs:
Exports a document as PDF from markdown content (e.g., from artifact download).

    This endpoint accepts markdown content directly and converts it to PDF format.
    It accepts pre-formatted markdown content and converts it directly to PDF.

    The markdown should already be formatted (e.g., from a previous artifact download).

    **Plan restriction:** Requires Pro or Enterprise plan. Free users receive a
    403 error with PLAN_UPGRADE_REQUIRED.

params.name: show_code_references
params.description: Include code references in user stories

params.name: search
params.description: Free-text; supports exact, "a or b", or "a and b"

items.docs:
Initiates asynchronous PDF generation for a document.

    Returns immediately with a job_id and URLs for tracking progress:
    - stream_url: Real-time SSE updates (subscribe for progress events)
    - result_url: Download the completed PDF

    The PDF generation runs in the background via ARQ workers. Clients should:
    1. Subscribe to stream_url for real-time progress via SSE
    2. When status is 'completed', download the PDF from result_url

    Document types:
    - prd: Full Product Req

info.name: Stream PDF generation progress via SSE

items.docs:
Stream real-time progress updates for a PDF generation job using Server-Sent Events (SSE).

    This endpoint provides live progress updates as the PDF is being generated, without
    requiring polling. It uses Redis Pub/Sub to receive events from the ARQ worker,
    making it work seamlessly across Kubernetes pods.

items.docs:
Download the completed PDF for a finished job.

    This endpoint returns the PDF binary content with appropriate headers
    for browser download. After successful download, the PDF file is
    deleted from storage, while the SOTJ job record is retained for audit purposes.

    Clients should call this endpoint after the status endpoint returns
    'completed' status.

    Returns:
        - 200: PDF binary content (application/pdf)

info.name: Export document as Word (.docx) from markdown input

params.name: doc_type
params.description: Optional document type for filename generation

items.docs:
Exports a document as Word (.docx) from markdown content.

    This endpoint accepts pre-formatted markdown content and converts it to a
    Word document using Pandoc. Mermaid diagrams are rendered as embedded images.

    **Plan restriction:** Requires Pro or Enterprise plan. Free users receive a
    403 error with PLAN_UPGRADE_REQUIRED.
